steps.say: With a subject found, the buttons at the bottom of the panel make the report images. Capture Map, the Winnipeg overall map, the Addenda Pack, and Export C S V.

Capture Map renders the view at 1950 by 1050 pixels, six and a half by three and a half inches at 300 d p i. With zoning shaded, Include legend becomes available. Scale bar and north arrow are optional.
Copy image puts it on the clipboard for Word. Download P N G or the smaller J P G saves a file. Alt C copies the current view with no dialog.
Wpg Overall Map draws the city location map with a subject callout. Edit the callout text and position. Downtown subjects get a twin-arrow inset automatically.

Addenda Pack builds the full set in one click. A location map, a neighbourhood map named and framed on the subject's neighbourhood cluster, a subject aerial from the newest City photography with dimensions, a zoning map, and a results map when there are several parcels.
The button shows each stage as it renders. The map view is restored at the end, and the zip downloads with a readme.
Export C S V writes the table as shown, and warns first if any rows are unticked. That completes the Property Search tools for Winnipeg.
